Shani Pradosh Vrat: Observance and Rituals

Shani Pradosh Vrat is a Hindu observance dedicated to Lord Shiva and Shani Dev. It is marked by specific rituals, including the recitation of a particular story (katha) and mantras. Devotees believe that observing this vrat can lead to blessings from Lord Shiva, alleviate suffering, and bring prosperity and success. The observance is also associated with astrological benefits, such as mitigating the effects of 'Saadesaati' and 'Dhaiyya'.
